Source/YAML/expression and actual Node/Bash/process-host contracts were exercised. No installer, Docker, browser renderer or native app was launched.
Imported E2E files and other supporting suites were read or parsed as evidence and discovery inputs; they are not counted reviewed or executed suites.
Body-loop scenarios execute within registered assertions and are source input scenarios; several normalize to identical shell environments. They are not additional runtime test registrations.
Parent tracked integration, refreshed inventory and CI remain pending.
rationale: Keep the declared directory owner alongside its direct unit consumer, and exclude that owner for an unrelated source. The opaque-negative assertion verifies the ownership declaration actually became effective. Keep the added-directory member plus direct-consumer control: without the direct consumer a full fallback could make the owner appear selected even when directory ownership is broken. The explicit full:false assertion distinguishes the intended path. Keep entry-point ownership separately from shared-helper ownership: the alternate caller remains conservative while the entry is selected for domain, helper and self changes. Preserving helper opacity is intentional. Keep the accepted dependency-context control followed by a changed lockfile and changed shared setup source. These are separate invalidation boundaries that prevent stale ownership from shrinking selection. Keep both deletion-only and delete-plus-rename vectors. The missing old path must force the full inventory even though the new path is present. Keep all six invalid/unowned ownership rows: absence, stale closure digest, duplicate owner record, traversal, backslash and glob inputs. Each must preserve the otherwise-unrelated indirect consumer and helper opacity. Keep imported-options drift: changing a statically reachable helper must invalidate the otherwise valid owner's closure digest and retain the conservative consumer. Keep the newly added JavaScript sibling. The graph deliberately retains every plausible resolution, so adding another candidate changes the closure despite leaving the original TypeScript file unchanged. FIX the fixture to retain its real census-options import while adding the missing import. Originally the claimed matching digest included options although the source no longer imported it; digest mismatch could reject independently. With the known edge retained, deleting the unresolved-closure guard would expose the matching known-source digest and clear opacity. Keep accepted empty-environment and rejected populated-environment controls against the real ownership validator. They make the environment requirement causal rather than merely testing a missing record.

it('runs cross-version wire checks for every working-tree wire module', () => {
    for (const file of [
      'src/shared/protocol-version.ts',
      'src/shared/terminal-stream-protocol.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-wire.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-provider-handle.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-mutation-envelope.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-journal-item-key.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-journal-types.ts',
      'src/main/ai-vault/structured-session-ownership.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-cursor.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-reducer.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-row-schema.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-wire/structured-agent-session-host.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/agent-session-record-store.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/dispatcher.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/ai-vault.ts',
      'src/shared/rpc-contract/browser-tab-create-params.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-gate.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-hold.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-schemas.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/terminal.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-agent-rows.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-pty-agent-sources.ts',
      'src/shared/runtime-worktree-contracts.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
      'src/shared/structured-agent-session-projection.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-turn-outcome.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/db.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/orchestration-schema-version-skew.ts'
    ]) {
      expectClassification([file], {
        'cross-version-wire': true,
        package: true,
        package_windows: true,
        // The session-tabs RPC publishes layout, so the layout oracle gates it too.
        layout_oracle: file === 'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts'
      })
    }
    expectClassification(
      ['tests/e2e/cross-version-wire/cross-version-terminal-wire.unit.test.ts'],
      { 'cross-version-wire': true }
    )
  })

it('runs cross-version wire checks for every working-tree wire module', () => {
    for (const file of [
      'src/shared/protocol-version.ts',
      'src/shared/terminal-stream-protocol.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-wire.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-provider-handle.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-mutation-envelope.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-journal-item-key.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-journal-types.ts',
      'src/main/ai-vault/structured-session-ownership.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-cursor.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-reducer.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-row-schema.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-wire/structured-agent-session-host.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/agent-session-record-store.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/dispatcher.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/ai-vault.ts',
      'src/shared/rpc-contract/browser-tab-create-params.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-gate.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-hold.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-schemas.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/terminal.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-agent-rows.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-pty-agent-sources.ts',
      'src/shared/runtime-worktree-contracts.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
      'src/shared/structured-agent-session-projection.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-turn-outcome.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/db.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/orchestration-schema-version-skew.ts'
    ]) {
      expectClassification([file], {
        'cross-version-wire': true,
        package: true,
        package_windows: true,
        // The session-tabs RPC publishes layout, so the layout oracle gates it too.
        layout_oracle: file === 'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts'
      })
    }
    expectClassification(
      ['tests/e2e/cross-version-wire/cross-version-terminal-wire.unit.test.ts'],
      { 'cross-version-wire': true }
    )
  })

      'src/shared/protocol-version.ts',

      'src/shared/agent-session-wire.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-session-provider-handle.ts',

      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-cursor.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-reducer.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-journal/journal-row-schema.ts',
      'src/main/native-chat/agent-session-wire/structured-agent-session-host.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/agent-session-record-store.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/dispatcher.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/ai-vault.ts',
      'src/shared/rpc-contract/browser-tab-create-params.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-gate.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-hold.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/structured-agent-session-schemas.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/terminal.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-agent-rows.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/runtime-worktree-pty-agent-sources.ts',
      'src/shared/runtime-worktree-contracts.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
      'src/shared/structured-agent-session-projection.ts',
      'src/shared/agent-turn-outcome.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/db.ts',
      'src/main/runtime/orchestration/orchestration-schema-version-skew.ts'
    ]) {
      expectClassification([file], {
        'cross-version-wire': true,
        package: true,
        package_windows: true,
        // The session-tabs RPC publishes layout, so the layout oracle gates it too.
        layout_oracle: file === 'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/session-tabs.ts'
      })
    }
    expectClassification(

      { 'cross-version-wire': true }
    )

it('keeps the client-only unit suite out of real Codex binary checks', () => {
    const unit = 'src/main/codex/codex-app-server-client.test.ts'
    const expected = {
      should_run: true,
      static_analysis: true,
      typecheck: true,
      git_compatibility: false,
      codex_index_heal_contract: false,
      xterm_patch_sync: false,
      shell_contracts: false,
      test: true,
      orcad_browser: false,
      mobile_web_app: false,
      'cross-version-wire': false,
      managed_hook_node18: false,
      package: false,
      package_windows: false
    }
    expect(classifyPrJobs([unit])).toMatchObject(expected)
    expect(
      classifyPrJobs([
        unit,

})

it('routes P0 sentinels from their causal sources', () => {
    const cases = [
      [
        'src/renderer/src/components/tab-bar/TabBarQuickCommandsMenu.tsx',
        'tests/e2e/terminal-quick-command-pre-bind-recovery.spec.ts'
      ],
      ['src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-files.ts', 'tests/e2e/paired-quick-open-large-tree.spec.ts'],
      [
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph.ts',
        'tests/e2e/host-parked-pane-remote-viewer.spec.ts'
      ],
      [
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
        'tests/e2e/paired-remote-terminal-materialization-reconnect.spec.ts'
      ],
      [
        'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/remote-pane-layout-push.ts',
        'tests/e2e/paired-remote-pane-layout-retry.spec.ts'
      ]
    ]
    for (const [source, spec] of cases) {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source]), source).toEqual([spec])
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source.replace(/\.tsx?$/, '.test.ts')]), source).toEqual([])
      expect(existsSync(join(projectDir, spec)), spec).toBe(true)
    }
    const parkedSplitSpec = 'tests/e2e/terminal-parked-cli-split.spec.ts'
    for (const source of [
      'src/main/window/attach-main-window-services.ts',
      'src/preload/api/ui-command-event-api.ts',
      'src/preload/index.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/terminal-pane-split-request-routing.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/use-terminal-pane-lifecycle.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/use-terminal-tab-cold-parking.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/hooks/ipc-events/terminal-ui-routing-ipc-bridge.ts'
    ]) {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source]), source).toContain(parkedSplitSpec)
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source.replace(/\.ts$/, '.test.ts')]), source).not.toContain(
        parkedSplitSpec
      )
    }
    expect(existsSync(join(projectDir, parkedSplitSpec)), parkedSplitSpec).toBe(true)

    const restartContinuitySpec = 'tests/e2e/paired-remote-terminal-serve-restart-binding.spec.ts'
    for (const source of [
      'src/main/daemon/daemon-attach-only-retirement.ts',
      'src/main/daemon/daemon-pty-applied-size.ts',
      'src/main/daemon/daemon-pty-session-control.ts',
      'src/main/daemon/daemon-pty-spawn-result.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/remote-runtime-pty-transport.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/terminal-error-accumulation.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-runtime-terminal-creation.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-runtime-session-tab-lifecycle.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-tabs-sync/use-web-session-tabs-sync.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-adoption.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-surface.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-inventory.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-inventory-validation.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-cache.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-pane.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-queue.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-recovery-rpc-lane.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-terminal-orphan-topology.ts'
    ]) {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source]), source).toContain(restartContinuitySpec)
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([source.replace(/\.ts$/, '.test.ts')]), source).not.toContain(
        restartContinuitySpec
      )
    }
    expect(existsSync(join(projectDir, restartContinuitySpec)), restartContinuitySpec).toBe(true)
    const quickCommandSpec = 'tests/e2e/terminal-quick-command-pre-bind-recovery.spec.ts'
    for (const source of [
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection/connect-pane-pty.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection/fresh-spawn-start.ts',
      'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection/pane-pty-visibility-bind.ts',

It proves the route output while documenting the workflow's deletion exclusion; no synthetic deletion execution is claimed. Keep the rollback oracle's PR-base/HEAD range and two recipe-schema authority strings. Those authorities must participate in the real workflow's path-scoped compatibility gate. Keep every P0 source/spec pair, per-source test-suffix exclusion, parked-split and restart-continuity inputs, quick-command transport inputs, ripgrep route, deduplication and unrelated/fixture negatives. These deliberately exercise different sentinel selections, not one copied output inventory. it('executes both Docker network routes in a Node job with their opt-in enabled', () => {
    const spec = 'tests/e2e/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.docker.unit.test.ts'
    const job = workflow.jobs['ssh-browser-network-route']
    const install = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
    )
    const run = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.name === 'Run Docker SSH browser network route journeys'
    )
    expect(job['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-latest')
    expect(job.if).toContain("inputs.test_files == ''")
    expect(job.if).toContain(spec)
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(run.env.ORCA_RUN_DOCKER_SSH_BROWSER_E2E).toBe('1')
    expect(run.run).toContain(`vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts ${spec}`)
    expect(run['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
    expect(DEDICATED_E2E_SPECS).toContain(spec)
    for (const changed of [
      spec,
      'src/main/browser/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-deferred-socket.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-execution-route.ts',
      'src/main/browser/system-ssh-socks-client-socket.ts',
      'src/main/ssh/system-transport/system-ssh-dynamic-forward-process.ts',
      'tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-target.ts',
      'tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-image.ts'
    ]) {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([changed])).toContain(spec)
    }
    expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(['src/renderer/src/components/Unrelated.tsx'])).not.toContain(spec)
    expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(['tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-terminal-tabs.ts'])).not.toContain(
      spec
    )
  })

describe('pr-e2e-layout-oracle-routing', () => {
  /** One product file per layout writer family; each alone must run the oracle. */
  const LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES = [
    'src/shared/workspace-layout/workspace-layout-pane-commands.ts',
    'src/shared/workspace-layout/old-client/old-client-session-tab-rows.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-topology-commit.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/restoring-sessions/session-owner-fields.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/loading-store/pty-binding-persistence.ts',
    'src/main/remote-layout-snapshot/remote-layout-snapshot-recorder.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/launch/terminal-split-surface.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/adoption/adopt-terminal-orphans-from-inventory.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/runtime-terminal-orphan-adoption.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/headless-tab-group-moves.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/launch/terminal-create.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/stop/worktree-terminal-stop.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/runtime/mobile-session-tab-close.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/runtime/runtime-layout-client.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/tabs.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/tabs/tabs-move-actions.ts',
    'tests/e2e/workspace-layout-oracle-known-on-main.ts',
    'tests/e2e/helpers/workspace-layout-oracle-compare.ts',
    ...LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS
  ]

  /** Widened while the layout-holder stack is open: these still write layout. */
  const STACK_WRITERS = [
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/terminals.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/TerminalPane.tsx',
    'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-tabs-sync/store-patch.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/launch/terminal-split.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/workspaces/workspace-file-session-targets.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-graph/session-window-graph.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/mobile-session-hydration.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/mobile-session-reconciliation.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/mobile-session-preservation.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/workspaces/session-hosts/get-runtime-id.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/mobile-session-layout-projection.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/headless-runtime-graph.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/loading-store/session-host-partitions.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/loading-store/workspace-session-snapshot-publication.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/tab-group-reference-repair.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/terminal-session-row-hydration.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/workspace-layout-cache.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/app-shell/use-runtime-graph-sync.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/components/tab-group/tab-drag-drop-commit.ts',
    'src/shared/remote-layout-snapshot.ts',
    'src/shared/terminal-leaf-move.ts',
    'src/main/ipc/pty/ipc/leaf-move.ts',
    'src/main/persistence/closed-terminal-tab-write-fence.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/runtime-workspace-session-controller.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/has-exact-persisted-terminal-surface-identity.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal-surface-close.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/output/terminal-derived-agent-facts.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/output/terminal-output-generation.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/mobile-session-membership.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/pty-backed-session-publication.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/components/terminal/terminal-tab-actions.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/components/tab-bar/web-runtime-tab-move-mirror.ts',
    'src/shared/rpc-contract/workspace-layout-params.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/recently-closed-tabs.ts'
  ]

  /** Every test file the oracle specs import, transitively: a change there can break the gate. */
  const oracleHarnessFiles = () => testImportClosure(projectDir, LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS)

  describe('workspace layout oracle merge gate', () => {
    it('routes each layout authority and stack writer on its own', () => {
      for (const file of [...LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES, ...STACK_WRITERS]) {
        expect(isLayoutOracleSource(file), file).toBe(true)
        expect(classifyPrJobs([file]).layout_oracle, file).toBe(true)
        expect(existsSync(join(projectDir, file)), file).toBe(true)
      }
    })

    it('routes every test file the oracle specs import', () => {
      const harness = oracleHarnessFiles()
      expect(harness.length).toBeGreaterThan(LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS.length)
      expect(harness.filter((file) => !isLayoutOracleSource(file))).toEqual([])
    })

    it('leaves tests, fixtures, harnesses and unrelated runtime modules alone', () => {
      for (const file of [
        'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-topology-commit.test.ts',
        'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-leaf-move-fixture.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-tests/mobile-session-tabs-part-03.spec.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/headless-tab-group-moves.test.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/headless-tab-group-moves-fixture.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/session-tabs/session-tabs-inventory-test-fixture.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/terminal/stop/worktree-terminal-stop.test.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/terminal/stop/worktree-terminal-stop-fixture.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/terminal/stop/worktree-terminal-stop.ts.backup',
        'src/main/runtime/terminal/stop/worktree-terminal-stop-extra.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/runtime-durable-store-fixture.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/orchestration/db/worker-terminal/worker-terminal-store.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/terminal/terminal-create.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/runtime-rpc-database.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-files.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/automation-operations.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/has-exact-persisted-terminal-surface-identity.test.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-tabs-sync-test-harness.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph-test-harness.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph.test.ts',
        'tests/e2e/workspace-layout-oracle-latency.spec.ts'
      ]) {
        expect(isLayoutOracleSource(file), file).toBe(false)
      }
      expect(classifyPrJobs(['src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-files.ts']).layout_oracle).toBe(false)
    })

    it('keeps the oracle specs out of the advisory e2e job', () => {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES)).toEqual([])
      expect(shouldRunReusablePrE2e(LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES)).toBe(false)
    })

    it('runs exactly the oracle specs, each in the lane that can run it', () => {
      const job = prWorkflow.jobs.layout_oracle

  /** One product file per layout writer family; each alone must run the oracle. */
  const LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES = [

    'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-topology-commit.ts',

    'src/renderer/src/app-shell/use-runtime-graph-sync.ts',
    'src/renderer/src/components/tab-group/tab-drag-drop-commit.ts',

    'src/shared/terminal-leaf-move.ts',

    'src/main/runtime/runtime-workspace-session-controller.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/has-exact-persisted-terminal-surface-identity.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal-surface-close.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/output/terminal-derived-agent-facts.ts',
    'src/main/runtime/terminal/output/terminal-output-generation.ts',

    'src/renderer/src/store/slices/recently-closed-tabs.ts'
  ]

  /** Every test file the oracle specs import, transitively: a change there can break the gate. */
  const oracleHarnessFiles = () => testImportClosure(projectDir, LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS)

  describe('workspace layout oracle merge gate', () => {
    it('routes each layout authority and stack writer on its own', () => {
      for (const file of [...LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES, ...STACK_WRITERS]) {
        expect(isLayoutOracleSource(file), file).toBe(true)
        expect(classifyPrJobs([file]).layout_oracle, file).toBe(true)
        expect(existsSync(join(projectDir, file)), file).toBe(true)
      }
    })

    it('routes every test file the oracle specs import', () => {
      const harness = oracleHarnessFiles()
      expect(harness.length).toBeGreaterThan(LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS.length)
      expect(harness.filter((file) => !isLayoutOracleSource(file))).toEqual([])
    })

    it('leaves tests, fixtures, harnesses and unrelated runtime modules alone', () => {
      for (const file of [
        'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-topology-commit.test.ts',
        'src/main/persistence/terminal-topology/terminal-leaf-move-fixture.ts',

        'src/main/runtime/orchestration/db/worker-terminal/worker-terminal-store.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/rpc/methods/terminal/terminal-create.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/runtime-rpc-database.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-files.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/automation-operations.ts',
        'src/main/runtime/workspaces/persisted-surfaces/has-exact-persisted-terminal-surface-identity.test.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/remote-runtime-terminal-multiplexer.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/web-session-tabs-sync-test-harness.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph-test-harness.ts',
        'src/renderer/src/runtime/sync-runtime-graph.test.ts',
        'tests/e2e/workspace-layout-oracle-latency.spec.ts'
      ]) {
        expect(isLayoutOracleSource(file), file).toBe(false)
      }
      expect(classifyPrJobs(['src/main/runtime/orca-runtime-files.ts']).layout_oracle).toBe(false)
    })

    it('keeps the oracle specs out of the advisory e2e job', () => {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES)).toEqual([])
      expect(shouldRunReusablePrE2e(LAYOUT_AUTHORITIES)).toBe(false)
    })

    it('runs exactly the oracle specs, each in the lane that can run it', () => {
      const job = prWorkflow.jobs.layout_oracle
      expect(job.uses).toBe('./.github/workflows/e2e.yml')
      // The merge commit, so a stale-base PR cannot pass on an old main.
      expect(job.with.ref).toBe('${{ github.sha }}')
      const specs = JSON.parse(job.with.test_files)
      expect(specs.toSorted()).toEqual(LAYOUT_ORACLE_E2E_SPECS.toSorted())
      // Window spec runs in the changed-spec lane; headless runs in the orcad lane.
      expect(selectGeneralE2eSpecs(specs)).toEqual(['tests/e2e/workspace-layout-oracle.spec.ts'])
      expect(classifyE2eJobs(job.with.test_files)).toEqual({
        e2e_run_changed: true,
        e2e_needs_build: true
      })
    })

    it('blocks the merge on the oracle and passes when it is skipped', () => {
      const verify = prWorkflow.jobs.verify
      const gate = verify.steps.find((step) => step.name === 'Require successful checks')
      expect(verify.needs).toContain('layout_oracle')
      expect(gate.run).toContain(
        'check_job layout_oracle "$LAYOUT_ORACLE" "$LAYOUT_ORACLE_SHOULD_RUN"'
      )
      // Two calls of the reusable workflow in one run must not share artifact names.
      expect(prWorkflow.jobs.layout_oracle.with.artifact_suffix).toBeTruthy()
      expect(prWorkflow.jobs.e2e.with.artifact_suffix).toBeUndefined()
    })
  })

it('executes both Docker network routes in a Node job with their opt-in enabled', () => {
    const spec = 'tests/e2e/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.docker.unit.test.ts'
    const job = workflow.jobs['ssh-browser-network-route']
    const install = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
    )
    const run = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.name === 'Run Docker SSH browser network route journeys'
    )
    expect(job['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-latest')
    expect(job.if).toContain("inputs.test_files == ''")
    expect(job.if).toContain(spec)
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(run.env.ORCA_RUN_DOCKER_SSH_BROWSER_E2E).toBe('1')
    expect(run.run).toContain(`vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts ${spec}`)
    expect(run['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
    expect(DEDICATED_E2E_SPECS).toContain(spec)
    for (const changed of [
      spec,
      'src/main/browser/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-deferred-socket.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-execution-route.ts',

it('executes both Docker network routes in a Node job with their opt-in enabled', () => {
    const spec = 'tests/e2e/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.docker.unit.test.ts'
    const job = workflow.jobs['ssh-browser-network-route']
    const install = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
    )
    const run = job.steps.find(
      (step) => step.name === 'Run Docker SSH browser network route journeys'
    )
    expect(job['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-latest')
    expect(job.if).toContain("inputs.test_files == ''")
    expect(job.if).toContain(spec)
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(run.env.ORCA_RUN_DOCKER_SSH_BROWSER_E2E).toBe('1')
    expect(run.run).toContain(`vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts ${spec}`)
    expect(run['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
    expect(DEDICATED_E2E_SPECS).toContain(spec)
    for (const changed of [
      spec,
      'src/main/browser/ssh-browser-network-execution-route.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-deferred-socket.ts',
      'src/main/browser/browser-network-execution-route.ts',
      'src/main/browser/system-ssh-socks-client-socket.ts',
      'src/main/ssh/system-transport/system-ssh-dynamic-forward-process.ts',
      'tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-target.ts',
      'tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-image.ts'
    ]) {
      expect(selectPrE2eSpecs([changed])).toContain(spec)
    }
    expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(['src/renderer/src/components/Unrelated.tsx'])).not.toContain(spec)
    expect(selectPrE2eSpecs(['tests/e2e/helpers/docker-ssh-host-terminal-tabs.ts'])).not.toContain(
      spec
    )
  })

rationale: Keep native-only lane exclusion, empty vector, general/future spec and mixed-vector positives plus shipped CLI-mode wiring. It protects allocation independently from native-source admission. Keep the complete pane-close lifecycle vector's exact three routed specs and reusable-workflow admission; this fixes the externally important routing regression the predicate table implements. Keep every unbind authority separately. The whole-vector case cannot detect five broken matches hidden by one working member. Keep existence of each routed close spec and source authority. Together with actual selector assertions, this prevents a renamed/deleted authority from leaving a green route contract over a nonexistent path. Keep each close-route neighboring module/test negative. Exact matching bounds the expensive lane to close/retirement decisions. Keep every layout authority and stack writer as a separate selector/classifier/existence control. Imported oracle specs are intentional positive inputs, not merely export inventory. Keep the transitive oracle test-import closure's per-member route check and nonempty-above-entry floor. This source graph changes with harness refactors and is not a hand-copied manifest. Keep all fixture, unit, backup/extra, unrelated runtime and manual latency exclusions plus the public classifier negative. These prevent broad runtime/name prefixes from allocating the required oracle. Keep required-oracle authority exclusion from advisory E2E and reusable allocation. This protects avoiding duplicate expensive oracle runs across the two workflows. Keep exact reusable-workflow/merge-SHA wiring, both oracle spec inputs, general-versus-headless partition and build allocation. This joins independent module routing to the real CI consumer. Keep required-needs membership, shell layout-result mapping and distinct artifact-suffix policy. Shell outcome semantics are executed by ready-check-gate; these assertions protect the layout-specific integration and artifact namespace. Keep actual Docker network job runner/runtime/opt-in/fatal-result wiring, dedicated exclusion, eight causal route inputs and two unrelated harness/product negatives. This is a workflow contract, not a claim of executing Docker in this suite. Keep all four serve-mode-switch source and harness paths, existence and reusable admission. These authorities can break the host-switch regression without editing the spec. Keep Windows startup authority and shared serve harness routing to the missing-AppData spec. The Windows-only lane remains distinct from a general Playwright route. Keep the three clipboard/source-transfer authorities, file existence and reusable admission to the Windows file-copy regression. Keep conversion source and four harness authorities individually, plus the colocated conversion unit negative. An internal unit edit should not allocate the managed Docker journey. FIX by removing the ignored third argument ORCAD_OPEN_IN_OWNER_E2E_SPEC from the two-argument expectRouted call. Preserve all five idle route/existence/admission controls. The separate owner case 6.T21 already covers twelve owner-specific sources/harnesses; idle product authorities are not claimed to route there. Keep each build-dependent dedicated/managed spec's changed:false/build:true decision and Docker lane's build prerequisite. Dedicated ownership must not accidentally drop the shared app build. Keep managed-prefix gate, configured/default shard expression, exact requested-spec array and shard argv propagation plus each journey spec's existence/prefix. This protects the real lane consumer rather than just a classifier flag. Keep the single Windows job's individual job/step conditions for all three specs and absence of diagnostic opt-in. Each requested spec must reach its one supported runner without executing unrelated specs. Keep all twelve owner guard/menu/harness authorities and the colocated unit negative. This is the actual owner route assertion; the removed extra idle-test argument never contributed to it. Keep the three journey specs crossed with thirteen harness/artifact/disconnect authorities, plus per-spec build decisions. The full cross-product ensures every consumer follows shared disconnect/reconnect changes. Keep discovery of all current managed SSH specs against route-owned specs with the explicit manual-only exemption. It detects newly added orphan specs rather than simply matching a fixed inventory. Keep all fourteen otherwise unnamed remote product authorities as individual managed-lane positives. They protect broader remote fallback coverage beyond the named route cases. Keep seven unit/local-only/docs negatives for the remote fallback lane. They prevent a broad remote-source trigger from swallowing unrelated local code.

cases.source:
it('shares one setup and overlaps the compiler only after type-aware checks finish', () => {
  expect(workflow.jobs.static_analysis).toBeUndefined()
  expect(workflow.jobs.typecheck).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.needs).toEqual(['code_paths'])
  expect(preflight['runs-on']).toBe('blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404')
  const installs = steps.filter(
    (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
  )
  expect(installs).toHaveLength(2)
  for (const install of installs) {
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(install.with['node-version']).toBe('24')
    expect(install.with['persist-native-cache']).not.toBe('false')
  }
  expect(steps[0].with['fetch-depth']).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2)
  expect(compiler.background).toBe(true)
  expect(compiler.run).toContain('pnpm run typecheck:ci')
  const bunSetup = steps.find((step) => step.name === 'Set up Bun for preflight checks')
  expect(bunSetup.with['bun-version-file']).toBe('config/.bun-version')
  expect(bunSetup.if).toBeUndefined()
  expect(plan.background).toBe(true)
  expect(plan.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'if [ "$PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED" != true ] || [ "$PREFLIGHT_PRIOR_SUCCESS" != true ]; then exit 0; fi',
    'node config/scripts/ci-unit-plan.mjs'
  ])
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE).toContain('vars.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE')
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT).toBe("${{ vars.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT || '5' }}")
  expect(steps.indexOf(plan)).toBeLessThan(compilerJoin)
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait === 'changed-code-quality')
  )
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeLessThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.id === 'localization-extraction')
  )
  expect(compilerJoin).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait?.includes('localization-extraction'))
  )
})

cases.source:
it('pins every foreground and background step to its selected phase', () => {
  const staticPhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.static_analysis == 'true'"
  const typePhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.typecheck == 'true'"
  const foreground = steps.filter(
    (step) => !step.background && /outputs\.(static_analysis|typecheck)/.test(step.if ?? '')
  )
  expect(foreground.map((step) => [step.name ?? step.run ?? step.uses, step.if])).toEqual([
    ['Check formatting', staticPhase],
    ['Reject low-evidence patterns', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce type-aware code-quality baseline', staticPhase],
    [
      './.github/actions/install-mobile-dependencies',
      `${staticPhase} && needs.code_paths.outputs.mobile_dependencies == 'true'`
    ],
    ['Verify locked audit tools', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce React Doctor on changed lines', staticPhase],
    ['Check Zustand selector fan-out budget', staticPhase],
    ['Check reliability gate manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce dead design-system classes', staticPhase],
    ['Check VM runtime rollback compatibility', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce ratchets', staticPhase],
    ['Check Node runtime pin', staticPhase],
    ['Check root and mobile lock the same shared dependencies', staticPhase],
    ['Decide whether the orcad terminal smoke runs', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated RPC params catalog', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated ACP protocol schema', staticPhase],
    ['Verify bundled skill guides', staticPhase],
    ['Verify skill freshness manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Verify localization coverage', staticPhase],
    ['Guard against project-owned .d.ts in preload/shared', staticPhase],
    ['Check feature wall asset budget', staticPhase],
    ['Verify macOS entitlements', staticPhase],
    ['actions/upload-artifact@v7', typePhase]
  ])
  expect(
    steps
      .filter((step) => step.background)
      .map((step) => [step.id, step.env.PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED])
  ).toEqual([
    ['process-host-imports', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['main-sync-spawn-ratchet', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['root-lint', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['native-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['changed-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['typecheck', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`],
    ['localization-extraction', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['localization-catalogs', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['unit-plan', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`]
  ])
})

cases.source:
it('runs the unchanged Node 18 smoke after every Node 24 step and preserves its required result', () => {
  const smoke = steps.at(-1)
  const receipt = workflow.jobs.managed_hook_node18
  expect(smoke.id).toBe('managed_hook_node18')
  expect(smoke.if).toBe("success() && needs.code_paths.outputs.managed_hook_node18 == 'true'")
  expect(smoke.env.NODE18_EXECUTABLE).toBe('${{ steps.node18_executable.outputs.executable }}')
  expect(smoke.env.ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH).toBe('1')
  expect(smoke.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'test -n "$NODE18_EXECUTABLE"',
    '"$NODE18_EXECUTABLE" config/scripts/smoke-process-host-node18.mjs'
  ])
  expect(smoke['continue-on-error']).toBe(true)
  expect(preflight['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18).toBe('${{ steps.managed_hook_node18.outcome }}')
  for (const background of steps.filter((step) => step.background)) {
    const joined = steps.findIndex((step) =>
      Array.isArray(step.wait) ? step.wait.includes(background.id) : step.wait === background.id
    )
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(background))
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeLessThan(steps.indexOf(smoke))
  }
  expect(receipt.name).toBe('managed hooks on Node 18')
  expect(receipt['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-slim')
  expect(receipt.steps).toHaveLength(1)
  expect(receipt.steps[0].uses).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0].env.MANAGED_HOOK_NODE18).toBe(
    '${{ needs.preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18 }}'
  )
  expect(receipt['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0]['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
})

it('shares one setup and overlaps the compiler only after type-aware checks finish', () => {
  expect(workflow.jobs.static_analysis).toBeUndefined()
  expect(workflow.jobs.typecheck).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.needs).toEqual(['code_paths'])
  expect(preflight['runs-on']).toBe('blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404')
  const installs = steps.filter(
    (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
  )
  expect(installs).toHaveLength(2)
  for (const install of installs) {
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(install.with['node-version']).toBe('24')
    expect(install.with['persist-native-cache']).not.toBe('false')
  }
  expect(steps[0].with['fetch-depth']).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2)
  expect(compiler.background).toBe(true)
  expect(compiler.run).toContain('pnpm run typecheck:ci')
  const bunSetup = steps.find((step) => step.name === 'Set up Bun for preflight checks')
  expect(bunSetup.with['bun-version-file']).toBe('config/.bun-version')
  expect(bunSetup.if).toBeUndefined()
  expect(plan.background).toBe(true)
  expect(plan.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'if [ "$PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED" != true ] || [ "$PREFLIGHT_PRIOR_SUCCESS" != true ]; then exit 0; fi',
    'node config/scripts/ci-unit-plan.mjs'
  ])
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE).toContain('vars.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE')
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT).toBe("${{ vars.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT || '5' }}")
  expect(steps.indexOf(plan)).toBeLessThan(compilerJoin)
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait === 'changed-code-quality')
  )
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeLessThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.id === 'localization-extraction')
  )
  expect(compilerJoin).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait?.includes('localization-extraction'))
  )
})

it('pins every foreground and background step to its selected phase', () => {
  const staticPhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.static_analysis == 'true'"
  const typePhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.typecheck == 'true'"
  const foreground = steps.filter(
    (step) => !step.background && /outputs\.(static_analysis|typecheck)/.test(step.if ?? '')
  )
  expect(foreground.map((step) => [step.name ?? step.run ?? step.uses, step.if])).toEqual([
    ['Check formatting', staticPhase],
    ['Reject low-evidence patterns', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce type-aware code-quality baseline', staticPhase],
    [
      './.github/actions/install-mobile-dependencies',
      `${staticPhase} && needs.code_paths.outputs.mobile_dependencies == 'true'`
    ],
    ['Verify locked audit tools', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce React Doctor on changed lines', staticPhase],
    ['Check Zustand selector fan-out budget', staticPhase],
    ['Check reliability gate manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce dead design-system classes', staticPhase],
    ['Check VM runtime rollback compatibility', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce ratchets', staticPhase],
    ['Check Node runtime pin', staticPhase],
    ['Check root and mobile lock the same shared dependencies', staticPhase],
    ['Decide whether the orcad terminal smoke runs', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated RPC params catalog', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated ACP protocol schema', staticPhase],
    ['Verify bundled skill guides', staticPhase],
    ['Verify skill freshness manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Verify localization coverage', staticPhase],
    ['Guard against project-owned .d.ts in preload/shared', staticPhase],
    ['Check feature wall asset budget', staticPhase],
    ['Verify macOS entitlements', staticPhase],
    ['actions/upload-artifact@v7', typePhase]
  ])
  expect(
    steps
      .filter((step) => step.background)
      .map((step) => [step.id, step.env.PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED])
  ).toEqual([
    ['process-host-imports', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['main-sync-spawn-ratchet', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['root-lint', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['native-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['changed-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['typecheck', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`],
    ['localization-extraction', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['localization-catalogs', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['unit-plan', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`]
  ])
})

it('runs the unchanged Node 18 smoke after every Node 24 step and preserves its required result', () => {
  const smoke = steps.at(-1)
  const receipt = workflow.jobs.managed_hook_node18
  expect(smoke.id).toBe('managed_hook_node18')
  expect(smoke.if).toBe("success() && needs.code_paths.outputs.managed_hook_node18 == 'true'")
  expect(smoke.env.NODE18_EXECUTABLE).toBe('${{ steps.node18_executable.outputs.executable }}')
  expect(smoke.env.ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH).toBe('1')
  expect(smoke.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'test -n "$NODE18_EXECUTABLE"',
    '"$NODE18_EXECUTABLE" config/scripts/smoke-process-host-node18.mjs'
  ])
  expect(smoke['continue-on-error']).toBe(true)
  expect(preflight['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18).toBe('${{ steps.managed_hook_node18.outcome }}')
  for (const background of steps.filter((step) => step.background)) {
    const joined = steps.findIndex((step) =>
      Array.isArray(step.wait) ? step.wait.includes(background.id) : step.wait === background.id
    )
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(background))
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeLessThan(steps.indexOf(smoke))
  }
  expect(receipt.name).toBe('managed hooks on Node 18')
  expect(receipt['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-slim')
  expect(receipt.steps).toHaveLength(1)
  expect(receipt.steps[0].uses).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0].env.MANAGED_HOOK_NODE18).toBe(
    '${{ needs.preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18 }}'
  )
  expect(receipt['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0]['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
})

it('shares one setup and overlaps the compiler only after type-aware checks finish', () => {
  expect(workflow.jobs.static_analysis).toBeUndefined()
  expect(workflow.jobs.typecheck).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.needs).toEqual(['code_paths'])
  expect(preflight['runs-on']).toBe('blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404')
  const installs = steps.filter(
    (step) => step.uses === './.github/actions/install-node-dependencies'
  )
  expect(installs).toHaveLength(2)
  for (const install of installs) {
    expect(install.with['native-runtime']).toBe('node')
    expect(install.with['node-version']).toBe('24')
    expect(install.with['persist-native-cache']).not.toBe('false')
  }
  expect(steps[0].with['fetch-depth']).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2)
  expect(compiler.background).toBe(true)
  expect(compiler.run).toContain('pnpm run typecheck:ci')
  const bunSetup = steps.find((step) => step.name === 'Set up Bun for preflight checks')
  expect(bunSetup.with['bun-version-file']).toBe('config/.bun-version')
  expect(bunSetup.if).toBeUndefined()
  expect(plan.background).toBe(true)
  expect(plan.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'if [ "$PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED" != true ] || [ "$PREFLIGHT_PRIOR_SUCCESS" != true ]; then exit 0; fi',
    'node config/scripts/ci-unit-plan.mjs'
  ])
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE).toContain('vars.ORCA_UNIT_SELECTION_MODE')
  expect(plan.env.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT).toBe("${{ vars.ORCA_UNIT_FULL_SHARD_COUNT || '5' }}")
  expect(steps.indexOf(plan)).toBeLessThan(compilerJoin)
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait === 'changed-code-quality')
  )
  expect(steps.indexOf(compiler)).toBeLessThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.id === 'localization-extraction')
  )
  expect(compilerJoin).toBeGreaterThan(
    steps.findIndex((step) => step.wait?.includes('localization-extraction'))
  )
})

it('pins every foreground and background step to its selected phase', () => {
  const staticPhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.static_analysis == 'true'"
  const typePhase = "needs.code_paths.outputs.typecheck == 'true'"
  const foreground = steps.filter(
    (step) => !step.background && /outputs\.(static_analysis|typecheck)/.test(step.if ?? '')
  )
  expect(foreground.map((step) => [step.name ?? step.run ?? step.uses, step.if])).toEqual([
    ['Check formatting', staticPhase],
    ['Reject low-evidence patterns', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce type-aware code-quality baseline', staticPhase],
    [
      './.github/actions/install-mobile-dependencies',
      `${staticPhase} && needs.code_paths.outputs.mobile_dependencies == 'true'`
    ],
    ['Verify locked audit tools', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce React Doctor on changed lines', staticPhase],
    ['Check Zustand selector fan-out budget', staticPhase],
    ['Check reliability gate manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce dead design-system classes', staticPhase],
    ['Check VM runtime rollback compatibility', staticPhase],
    ['Enforce ratchets', staticPhase],
    ['Check Node runtime pin', staticPhase],
    ['Check root and mobile lock the same shared dependencies', staticPhase],
    ['Decide whether the orcad terminal smoke runs', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated RPC params catalog', staticPhase],
    ['Verify the generated ACP protocol schema', staticPhase],
    ['Verify bundled skill guides', staticPhase],
    ['Verify skill freshness manifest', staticPhase],
    ['Verify localization coverage', staticPhase],
    ['Guard against project-owned .d.ts in preload/shared', staticPhase],
    ['Check feature wall asset budget', staticPhase],
    ['Verify macOS entitlements', staticPhase],
    ['actions/upload-artifact@v7', typePhase]
  ])
  expect(
    steps
      .filter((step) => step.background)
      .map((step) => [step.id, step.env.PREFLIGHT_PHASE_SELECTED])
  ).toEqual([
    ['process-host-imports', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['main-sync-spawn-ratchet', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['root-lint', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['native-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['changed-code-quality', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['typecheck', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`],
    ['localization-extraction', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['localization-catalogs', `\${{ ${staticPhase} }}`],
    ['unit-plan', `\${{ ${typePhase} }}`]
  ])
})

it('runs the unchanged Node 18 smoke after every Node 24 step and preserves its required result', () => {
  const smoke = steps.at(-1)
  const receipt = workflow.jobs.managed_hook_node18
  expect(smoke.id).toBe('managed_hook_node18')
  expect(smoke.if).toBe("success() && needs.code_paths.outputs.managed_hook_node18 == 'true'")
  expect(smoke.env.NODE18_EXECUTABLE).toBe('${{ steps.node18_executable.outputs.executable }}')
  expect(smoke.env.ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH).toBe('1')
  expect(smoke.run.trim().split('\n')).toEqual([
    'test -n "$NODE18_EXECUTABLE"',
    '"$NODE18_EXECUTABLE" config/scripts/smoke-process-host-node18.mjs'
  ])
  expect(smoke['continue-on-error']).toBe(true)
  expect(preflight['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18).toBe('${{ steps.managed_hook_node18.outcome }}')
  for (const background of steps.filter((step) => step.background)) {
    const joined = steps.findIndex((step) =>
      Array.isArray(step.wait) ? step.wait.includes(background.id) : step.wait === background.id
    )
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeGreaterThan(steps.indexOf(background))
    expect(joined, background.id).toBeLessThan(steps.indexOf(smoke))
  }
  expect(receipt.name).toBe('managed hooks on Node 18')
  expect(receipt['runs-on']).toBe('ubuntu-slim')
  expect(receipt.steps).toHaveLength(1)
  expect(receipt.steps[0].uses).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0].env.MANAGED_HOOK_NODE18).toBe(
    '${{ needs.preflight.outputs.managed_hook_node18 }}'
  )
  expect(receipt['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
  expect(receipt.steps[0]['continue-on-error']).toBeUndefined()
})

dependency_isolation.name: dependency isolation under the global virtual store

limitations: Runtime validation is direct Node Vitest on Linux only; platform skip guards are preserved, with no Windows or macOS execution claim.
Source/YAML/expression and actual Node/Bash/process-host contracts were exercised. No installer, Docker, browser renderer or native app was launched.
Imported E2E files and other supporting suites were read or parsed as evidence and discovery inputs; they are not counted reviewed or executed suites.
Body-loop scenarios execute within registered assertions and are source input scenarios; several normalize to identical shell environments. They are not additional runtime test registrations.
Parent tracked integration, refreshed inventory and CI remain pending.
rationale: Keep shared setup/native runtime/runtime pin, fetch depth, background compiler/planner guards and join ordering. The ordering protects memory and completed planning outputs, while actual admission behavior has independent cases below. Keep the canonical Bun pin and every discovered setup-bun step's pin-file/no-inline-version policy across all 68 pinned workflows. These are configuration authorities used by CI; the suite does not execute their installers. Keep actual workflow format-command versus package manifest format-script equivalence. It prevents local writes and CI checks from scanning different trees without copying a directory inventory. Keep anti-slop plugin preparation and normalized actual local/CI command equivalence. Both tool entrypoints intentionally differ but must enforce the same scan policy. Keep planner join/upload/consumer shard ordering, dependency wiring, four actual job-admission expression results and aggregate preflight mapping. The actual VM evaluations distinguish success from failed/cancelled/skipped prerequisites. Keep all 23 advisory-admission scenario rows. Each supplies independently expected admission across selected/unselected/missing phases, path results, route presence, preflight outcomes and cancellation. Keep both readiness reuse values through actual output expressions, preflight and advisory job gates. They prove that required-check reuse changes required phases while leaving advisory routing eligible. Keep each foreground/background step-to-phase pairing. This is CI work admission policy; its exact expected table catches a newly added ungated foreground or misassigned background step. Keep seven changed-path rows and their exact phase/mobile dependency triples, actual preflight/compiler expressions and test-phase equality. Docs, mobile, cloud, mixed and empty evidence have distinct intended behavior. Keep every background job's cancellation/prior-success environment and real no-op prefix. This is a wiring assertion; the audit does not overstate it as executed success-path coverage. Keep the combined import-analysis command, retired separate gate absence and localization checker wiring. The combined command's production implementation was read and calls both boundary checkers over one source/specifier inventory. Keep Node18 setup/capture conditions, selected-outcome VM evaluations, install ordering and restoration of Node24 with nonoptional installs. A failed optional runtime setup must not run an invalid capture or affect the current toolchain. Keep the final smoke command/environment/order across all background joins and separate required receipt mapping. A capability marker alone would not suffice; the next case executes refusal/result shell boundaries. Keep the actual missing-executable smoke shell plus six required-receipt outcome cases through real Bash. Native-focus or app launch is not involved, Windows skips explicitly, and runtime remains pending for this proposal.

CONSOLIDATE the identical missing-selector environment generated once per malformed value: retain all twelve malformed values per raw selector, but generate its missing-output control once after that inner loop. All fourteen raw selectors keep their absence guard. This preserves 182 retained input scenarios and removes 154 duplicate executions from the original 336; no declaration is removed. Keep both phase positions crossed with twelve malformed values, both other-phase selections and success/skipped preflight results. An apparently selected other phase must not mask invalid raw evidence.

rationale: Keep accepted identical evidence, empty and selected-unit-mode negatives, all five changed identity/current-run fields and four missing required identity fields. The reused result must be the same source/head/workflow/PR and a different run. Keep all nine unusable API evidence rows: active/queued status, failure/cancelled/skipped verdict, wrong event/workflow/title and nonpositive run id. A successful-looking receipt must satisfy each independent admission field. Keep actual lookup result, single request, workflow/head/status/page scope, default GET and bounded signal. The request mock supplies external API data only; it does not implement the identity or routing decision being tested. Keep all ordinary event actions, draft, absent-token and non-PR exclusions plus no-request assertion. Avoiding API lookup is the boundary being tested, not a substitute for behavior assertions elsewhere. Keep HTTP403, HTTP429, missing workflow_runs, thrown network error and empty page fallbacks. These are distinct fail-closed external boundaries; the production validator still decides evidence usability. Keep run-title provenance format, event subscription, read permissions, sparse checkout, exact lookup entrypoint, every required output mask, unaffected advisory outputs/draft filter and required aggregate needs. This is the CI integration for the separately exercised reuse function. Keep the independent test-LoC workflow's three event types and lack of draft dependence. Readiness-only events must not rerun a write-scoped body update unrelated to required-check reuse.
